name: DMS Theme Sync
author: arqueon
description: Make Dux Shell the source of truth for appearance and propagate it to GTK, Qt 5/6, KDE, Kvantum, Fontconfig, XWayland and terminals — theme, light/dark, fonts and sizes (optionally scaled by Dux's font scale), icons, cursor, the full terminal ANSI palette ladder, and a softened Niri focused border. Auto-sync on every Matugen change, hot reload for running apps, pre-apply backups, and automatic deferral to Dux 2.2's native icon and cursor pipelines.
